meta.name: attention-kind
meta.description: Answer in the ADHD-friendly Attention-kind style for the rest of this chat.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把聊天回复调成 ADHD 友好的清晰风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常觉得大段文字难以读完,想要更简洁的回复
copy.tagline_en: Make chat responses clear and ADHD-friendly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often find long paragraphs hard to read.

howto.what: 你的回复改为 Attention-kind 风格:每段用箭头和粗体标出结论、数字、风险和适用条件,一段只讲一件事;开头先给出最重要的一句,不写寒暄铺垫;除非用户明确要求深入,否则讲完必要的信息就停。
howto.when: 当用户要求改用 Attention-kind 风格后,技能从你的下一条回复开始生效,并持续作用于当前对话直到结束。

say.text: 接下来用 Attention-kind 风格回答我。
say.note: 回复会从结论开始,用短段落分块。

say.text: 用 Attention-kind 风格说说这个方案的风险。
say.note: 风险会单独列出,保留数字和适用条件。

say.text: 改用 Attention-kind 风格,先给我最重要的一个结论。
say.note: 你只先收到一行最重要的结论。

howto.what_en: Your replies switch to Attention-kind style: start with the key takeaway, short blank-line blocks with → and bold lead-ins for numbers/risks/conditions, no filler, stay brief unless the user explicitly asks for depth.
howto.when_en: Activates when the user asks for the Attention-kind style. From your next reply it stays on for the rest of the current chat.

say_en.text: Please use the Attention-kind style from now on.
say_en.note: Replies start with the bottom line in short bold blocks.

say_en.text: In Attention-kind style, walk me through the risks here.
say_en.note: Risks get their own points, numbers kept.

say_en.text: Switch to Attention-kind and give me the one key point first.
say_en.note: You get the single headline before anything else.
